verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own connector docs list re-sync at both connection and table level ('A parent table re-sync includes all associated child tables'), so a single table can be resynced without rebuilding the pipeline. This is shown only on one connector's (Akamai) feature table, not as a platform-wide capability, and a community user confirms full re-syncs in practice. History Mode is change tracking, not a historical backfill, so it is not credited. missing for 10: platform-wide documentation of table-level re-sync across connectors, explicit historical backfill or date-range re-sync capability, independent hands-on corroboration of single-table resync

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can backfill history or resync a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Re-sync | YES | Connection level and table level. A parent table re-sync includes all associated child tables.
We even had to do a full re-sync on a couple of occasions
